method: B1 research subagents read each scheduled job's script (and the scripts it calls) for fixed-path receipts, confirmed each file on the host (exists, mtime consistent with the schedule) and recorded a verified_token that reconcile_lane_registry.py re-checks against source_file. Only lanes with a host-confirmed, single-job receipt are listed; everything else keeps its scheduler log or is flagged UNVERIFIED_OUTPUT.
proposed_state_note: proposed_state applies only to a unit the host shows NOT enabled; it records what the cited document supports. It is a PROPOSAL for the operator, never a ruling (PR #1597 review): the generator keeps the row ACTIVE with status DISABLED_UNRULED and operator_decision_pending, and copies this block as proposed_state with ruled=false. It can never declare an enabled unit off.
